//: The pins for the codex-edit extension of @maxiaochao/pi-toolkit. One source for the A/B stand arm (arms.mjs), the verified installer (codex-edit-install.mjs) and stock codex Pi seats (ops/orchestrator/src/codex-edit.ts). integrity is the sha512 of the registry tarball, checked before npm sees the bytes. config is written next to index.ts because upstream ships gpt-5.6-* while the operator pinned gpt-6.1-sol (decision #13098). files are the extension files that decide behaviour; the installer records their sha256 and every stock seat start re-checks them. The order of files is the arm profileHash order: changing it invalidates recorded pilot hashes.
hashesNote: sha256 of the files as they sit in the tarball whose sha512 is the integrity pin (recomputed from those exact bytes). config.json is deliberately absent: orch overwrites it with `config`, and every check compares its parsed content with that pin.
